definitions.explanation: A formal, mostly written word for thanks, used in letters, speeches, notices and business greetings. It is the ceremonious counterpart of お{礼|れい}, and almost always appears in fixed phrases such as {御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます. The same spelling is also read おれい (= お{礼|れい}), and many speakers say おれい in that phrase; おんれい is the more ceremonious reading and the fixed one in {満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます。
⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: We are deeply grateful to all of you for your support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ご⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: Thank you very much for taking the time to come here today.

notes:
Belongs to formal writing and set speeches; in conversation, use ⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧ or simply ⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧. Shops also post ⟦{満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}→満員御礼：15457_maninonrei⟧ ("thank you: full house") and {御礼|おんれい} on notices of thanks.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます: I/we humbly offer our thanks
- ⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{御礼申|おんれいもう}し{上|あ}げます: we are deeply grateful
- ⟦{満員御礼|まんいんおんれい}→満員御礼：15457_maninonrei⟧: sold out, full house (sign at sumo, theatres)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧: thanks, a thank-you gift — the everyday word
- ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧: gratitude — the feeling itself
